signals.claim: 0% bust rate for year 3-5 WRs age 23 or younger — vs 17% for year 3-5 WRs (2020-2025, n=22)
signals.detail: Cohort: year 3-5 WRs age 23 or younger. Boom 18% · hit 64% · bust 0% · median +6 pts vs slot expectation. n=22, 2020-2025. Baseline: year 3-5 WRs at 17% (n=165). Boom/bust = top/bottom 20% of outcomes for the same position and draft slot.
